boundary: Data-only offline records. Prototype field/copy/reference behavior is checked; no robot configuration, frame, geometry, storage-layout or controller runtime equivalence is claimed.

rules.documented: XYZWPR exposes X/Y/Z/W/P/R REAL fields and CONFIG_DATA of CONFIG type, all read-write. VECTOR exposes read-write X/Y/Z REAL fields. Positions are referenced to a coordinate frame in KAREL.
rules.implemented: Exact built-in type identities, global/local declarations, structure fields, fixed/named 1D/2D/3D arrays, scalar field reads/writes and exact-type reference parameters. REAL fields use the existing conservative exact binary32 normal-or-zero model. INTEGER assignment promotes through that REAL guard.
rules.restriction: The record contains only offline values. No motion-group/frame metadata is introduced. Cross-type positional conversion, POSITION geometry operators, builtin record USING and record READ/WRITE remain blocked.
rules.tests: tests/test_data_records.py: field/type/context, exactness, reference and rejection checks

rules.feature: CONFIG fields and conservative turn range
rules.documented: CONFIG contains CFG_TURN_NO1/2/3 INTEGER and CFG_FLIP/LEFT/UP/FRONT BOOLEAN fields. Oversized compact fields produce an abort. Chapter 8 Table 8.1 lists turn numbers -8 through 7, while requiring robot-specific configuration validity.
rules.implemented: Strict initialized INTEGER and BOOLEAN writes. Turn storage is guarded to -8..7 before mutation. Initial scalar leaves are uninitialized; individual scalar UNINIT remains supported. Copy validation rechecks turn ranges, including nested records and arrays.
rules.restriction: This is a conservative prototype range, not proof of physical bit layout, exact controller overflow/alarm behavior, joint assignment, kinematics or robot-specific reachability/configuration validity. Whole-record UNINIT remains blocked.
rules.tests: tests/test_data_records.py: valid endpoints, strict types, failed-write preservation, range rechecking and initialization

rules.feature: CONFIG subfields always passed by value
rules.documented: Each CONFIG subfield can be a routine argument, but is always passed by value. The general reference rule applies to ordinary variables; value arguments own temporaries.
rules.implemented: Direct, nested, array-selected and forwarded CONFIG scalar subfields create independent INTEGER/BOOLEAN/REAL value temporaries for internal user calls. Index expressions are evaluated once. Ordinary XYZWPR/VECTOR REAL fields still pass by reference when bare. Whole exact-type CONFIG records pass by reference. Static sites are reported in config_subfield_arguments.
rules.restriction: CONFIG subfields as conversion-procedure output aliases remain blocked with E_CONFIG_OUTPUT. Effect analysis remains conservative and may overestimate writes through a CONFIG-subfield argument. Exact initialized record values/results use positional_routine_semantics.json; positional conversions remain blocked.
rules.tests: tests/test_data_records.py: value isolation, reference forwarding, numeric promotion, evaluation count and cleanup

rules.documented: CONFIG permits assignment and parameter passing; VECTOR assignments require VECTOR values. XYZWPR exposes its components as a predefined structure. General assignment and reference rules distinguish copied values from shared storage.
rules.implemented: Fully initialized exact-type whole-record and record-array copies are independent and preserve existing destination aggregate storage recursively, so captured REAL-field and whole-CONFIG references survive replacement. Allocation counts all record scalar leaves against the existing 32767-leaf limit.
rules.restriction: Partial copies fail before destination mutation. Built-in types remain distinct from same-shaped user structures. Exact-type data copy is an offline policy; frame transformations and physical alias/storage behavior are unvalidated.
rules.tests: tests/test_data_records.py: deep copies, complete-initialization guards, nested arrays/structures and stable captured references

unresolved: Robot/group axis-count and unit mapping; POSITION initialization and read-only argument behavior remain separate gaps
Group/frame metadata, positional conversions, coordinate transforms, kinematics and configuration validity
POSITION operators, literal constructors and native aggregate return/value behavior
Partial-copy behavior, whole-record initialization predicates, physical layout and alias behavior
Record/file I/O, register/controller adapters and motion

position_update.boundary: POSITION orientation fields are recursively read-only and start uninitialized; writable location/configuration and extra-axis data rules are separate from geometry or controller behavior.

joint_update.boundary: JOINTPOS is a distinct opaque type, not a record with invented axis fields. Exact-width copy/reference/array forms and explicit-context conversions are supported.

vector_update.boundary: Checked initialized VECTOR arithmetic, scaling/division, equality, cross/dot products; POSITION transforms and general rounding remain unsupported.

unpos_update.boundary: Exact XYZWPR extraction only; six REAL outputs plus CONFIG; disjoint references and preflight guards. No positional coercion, POS constructor or controller semantics.

vector_routine_update.boundary: Exact initialized VECTOR results and writable value copies are supported. Bare protected orientation arguments, effect/order guards and controller boundaries remain; positional values use positional_routine_semantics.json.

positional_routine_update.boundary: Exact initialized CONFIG/XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT/POSITION and exact-width JOINTPOS results/writable value copies are supported. POSITION protection, CONFIG scalar value-only passing, effects and conversion-context guards remain; no frame, kinematic or controller behavior is supplied.
